text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Iraqi children hail President Saddam Hussein's birthday.
- Saddam receives well-wishers on his birthday anniversary.
- Arab and foreign personalities congratulate Saddam on his birthday.
- Three more ships laden with wheat and barley anchor at Iraq's southern port of Umm Qasr.
- French television says Americans admit defeat of plans against Saddam's leadership.
- Izzat Ibrahim opens new mosque in Tikrit.
(The above were also carried by JUMHOURIYA and AL-IRAQ)
- Article says Labour Party will win Britain's next elections.
- Articles provide information on Saddam's childhood and early days of struggle.
- Fighting flares in Iraqi Kurdistan between the Patriotic Union of Kurdistan and the so-called Islamic movement.
- Kurds in Baghdad celebrate Saddam's birthday.
